`browser` is a bundled Consuelo OS skill. Uses the OS browser surface for known URLs, authenticated pages, rendered extraction, accessibility snapshots, screenshots, and live UI verification.

## When to use it

use for known-url browser work, rendered-page extraction, authenticated pages, live UI verification, Interact with docs and JS-heavy pages, screenshots, accessibility snapshots, and browser evidence. use when provided a URL to inspect, test or verify a webpage or UI, needs scraping/fetching from, wants screenshots or truth, or pages that require clicking, filling, login state, tabs, accordions, or auth. use built-in web search for discovery first, and use browser known-url, use togther.

Typical requests include:

- “Open this known URL and verify the signed-in UI.”
- “Take a screenshot and confirm the button is actually rendered.”

## Enable it

```bash
consuelo add skill browser
```

Run `consuelo add skill` without a name to choose from the skills that are not currently selected. Remove it with:

```bash
consuelo remove skill browser
```

## What the agent loads

The installed metadata points to `skills/browser/SKILL.md` in the immutable OS runtime. The compact steering catalog advertises the active skill by name and description; the full `SKILL.md` body is loaded only when the workflow applies.

Metadata for this skill currently declares permission `guidance` and `requiresApproval: no`. Those fields describe the skill contract; individual tools called by the skill still enforce their own authorization and safety rules.

## Boundary

Use web search for discovery. Use Browser when the URL or UI is known and runtime/browser evidence matters.

## Verify

After enabling it, confirm `~/Consuelo/Skills/browser/SKILL.md` exists and that `browser` appears in `<CONSUELO_HOME>/components/installed-skills.json`. A newly bootstrapped agent should then see `browser` in the Installed skills portion of steering.
